It explicitly states that this loss enforces a 'mixture of high-level semantic and low-level structural consistency' between a rendered image and a 'warped pseudo-ground-truth image' (acquired by warping input ground truth using predicted depth). Both sources confirm the use of MSC/consistency loss for structural and semantic regularization against reference or warped images within the domain of differentiable volume rendering.
